method: Enumerated every benchmark linked from https://www.vals.ai/benchmarks and https://www.vals.ai/home (61 distinct slugs; /benchmarks/snap redirects to public-benefits-bench and is not listed separately). Active = the 36 boards in the site's BenchmarkSelector plus SAFE-Teen (shown as active on the index); archived = boards in the index's 'View N archived benchmark(s)' lists plus three older versions linked only from /home (finance_agent, terminal-bench 1.0, ioi-v1). For each page the benchmarkViewUrl prop was read and the hashed /_astro/benchmark_view_*.json downloaded to vals-capture/<slug>.json (raw). rsi_index has no JSON: its JS data module was evaluated in an isolated node vm context and saved as JSON; mental-health (SAFE-Teen) data were extracted from the array literal in shared.Cs8tbNxH.js. Values come from tasks.overall.<model key>. Coverage: a cohort configuration is 'exact' when the Vals model key is the same model version and the record's reasoning_effort/compute_effort equals AA's effort; 'plausible' when AA has no effort label (MiMo-V2.6-Pro/Flash, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash) and Vals records null or max, or when the Vals record carries no effort and AA's effort equals Vals' usual effort for that model; otherwise 'absent' (no transfer across efforts or versions; the note gives what Vals has). deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash (Vals: released 2026-09-10) is a different release from deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 (2026-10-17) and is never mapped; anthropic/*-range keys are 'Claude Opus 5.5 (CVP)' / 'Cyber Range' access variants and are not mapped; native-agent rows (e.g. *-claude-code, *-codex) are separate keys and no cohort model has one. Descriptive fields were written from the captured page text (vals-capture/_pages/); 'not stated in page text' marks counts not found there. Model pages consulted for effort statements are in vals-capture/_models/.
